text:
Maya Chen: Heads up — thinking of a casual Sunday brunch + boardgames at Lark Park this weekend. Sunny forecast so picnic vibes? :sun_with_face:
Jordan Lee: love this. what time were you thinking?
Maya Chen: 11am meetup near the big oak by the east playground. that'll give people time to sleep in 😅
Samir Patel: count me in. bringing Catan and sushi (yes both). :raised_hands:
Li Nguyen: I can bring snacks and a picnic blanket. is there a rain backup plan?
Maya Chen: if it rains we'll move to The Nook (indoor cafe across the street) — they said we can spread out.
Alex Rivera: can we make this kid-friendly? my niece might tag along.
Maya Chen: totally fine — family + friends welcome. low-key vibes.
Jordan Lee: quick poll — who wants boardgames (tabletop) vs just hanging/brunch? react with :game_die: for games, :pancakes: for chill brunch.
Samir Patel: :game_die:
Li Nguyen: :pancakes: (might switch to games later)
Alex Rivera: :game_die:
Maya Chen: jotting down RSVP: Samir, Li, Jordan, Alex, Maya — anyone else?
Samir Patel: also if anyone needs a ride from downtown I can do one for two people.
Jordan Lee: can we put it on the calendar? otherwise I might forget.
calendar-bot: Event created — "Brunch & Boardgames @ Lark Park" on Sunday 11:00 AM. RSVP link: https://cal.example.com/event/3271
Maya Chen: added the link above. please RSVP there so I can estimate chairs/food. see you all! :sparkles:
